Mahbubey Alam, Attorney General, instructed by Mr. Abu Sams Md. Khalequzzaman, Advocate-on-Record ------ For the Petitioner

Vs.

full_judgment:
Muhammad Imman Ali J.: This petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 15.01.2009 passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 481 of 2008 making the Rule absolute. 

 2. The facts necessary for disposal of the instant leave petition are that the respondent was an accused in Muksudpur Police Station Case No. 3 dated 03.06.2001 under sections 324/326/302/307/34 of the Penal Code which was registered as G.R. No. 69/2001, and is pending in the Court of Magistrate 1st Class; Cognizance Court No. 2, Gopalganj. 

 4. The respondent was arrested on 16.08.2006 but no police report has been submitted. The respondent petitioner moved an application for bail which was rejected by the Magistrate, 1st Class, Gopalganj against which he preferred Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 332 of 2006 before the Sessions Judge, Gopalganj and prayed for bail which was also rejected. The respondent then filed Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 481 of 2008 before the High Court Division. By the impugned judgment and order the Rule was made absolute and the respondent-petitioner was enlarged on bail. The State has filed the Instant Criminal Petition for Leave to Appeal before this Division challenging the judgment and order of the High Court Division. 

 7. We find that the High Court Division has properly considered the facts and circumstances of the case and the decision of the High Court Division does not call for any interference by this Division.
